author: Chris Schommer
title: Brady Singer deals on mound in shutout loss
desc: Brady Singer allowed one earned run on four hits and one walk while striking out five over 7 1/3 innings in Thursday's loss to the Phillies.
impact: Singer continues a strong stretch on the mound of late, allowing two earned runs or less in five of his last six trips to the mound. The right-hander remains one of the more risky starting options in the Reds rotation for manager Terry Francona, posting a 4.72 ERA and 1.47 WHIP with a 3-9 record and 7.6 K/9 ratio across 18 starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Zach McKinstry goes deep in win over Athletics
desc: Zach McKinstry went 1-for-4 in Thursday's win over the Athletics with a two-run home run.
impact: McKinstry continues a productive stretch of late, getting on base in six of his last seven contests. The 31-year-old has disappointed for much of the season as one of many inconsistent options in the Tigers lineup, slashing .202 with four home runs, 18 RBI, 20 runs scored, and one stolen base across 68 games.

author: Nate Miller
title: Jacob deGrom (hip) will not start Sunday
desc: Jacob deGrom (hip) will miss his scheduled start on Sunday against the Astros.
impact: Earlier this week, deGrom expressed his expectation to be ready for Sunday's start. That will not happen. The Rangers will hold the ace righty out through the All-Star break, and possibly a little longer. A trip to the IL has not been ruled out.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jake Rogers goes yard in win over Athletics
desc: Jake Rogers went 1-for-1 in Thursday's win over the Athletics with a solo home run and two walks.
impact: Rogers has flashed his power stroke of late, homering in each of his last two contests. The catcher remains one of the more underwhelming bats when in the lineup for manager AJ Hinch, batting .171 with three home runs, nine RBI, 10 runs scored, and one stolen base across 31 games.

author: Chase Davis
title: Bobby Witt Jr. runs into one as Royals fall 7-3
desc: Bobby Witt Jr. went 1-for-4 in loss to the Mets with a home run, a run scored, and one RBI.
impact: After Thursday's loss to New York, Witt is batting .288 with 13 home runs, 39 RBI, 50 runs scored and 30 stolen bases across 88 games. He's only three steals behind league leader Nasim Nunez of the Washington Nationals.

author: Chase Davis
title: Lane Thomas goes deep, but Royals can't keep pace in 7-3 loss
desc: Lane Thomas went 1-for-4 in loss to the Mets with a home run, one run scored, one RBI and one strikeout.
impact: Through 79 games, Thomas is batting .233 with seven homers, 30 RBI, 26 runs scored and four stolen bases alongside a .326 wOBA. He's been hot at the plate recently with eight hits and seven RBI in his last five games. He's in the middle of a modest seven-game hit streak.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Kenley Jansen locks down save in win over Athletics
desc: Kenley Jansen struck out one batter while allowing one hit and one walk over a scoreless frame to earn the save in Thursday's 4-1 win over the Athletics.
impact: Jansen continues a solid stretch out of the bullpen, holding opponents scoreless in seven of his last nine contests. The right-hander has fought inconsistent stretches  in high-leverage situations for manager AJ Hinch, posting a 4.76 ERA and 1.24 WHIP with 11 saves, one hold, and a 9.5 K/9 ratio across 26 appearances.

author: Chase Davis
title: Michael Wacha gets shelled early as Royals fall 7-3
desc: Michael Wacha allowed six earned runs on six hits and three walks while striking out five over 4.2 innings in Thursday's loss to the Mets.
impact: Wacha allowed five hard-hit balls and picked up 10 whiffs on 104 pitches. This was the first outing all year where he has failed to complete five or more innings. After the loss, he holds a 3.77 ERA and 1.19 WHIP with a 5-7 record across 19 starts. His next opportunity will come after the All-Star break against the Padres.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Framber Valdez cruises through seven in win over Athletics
desc: Framber Valdez allowed one earned run on three hits while striking out nine over seven innings in Thursday's win over the Athletics.
impact: Valdez has offered mixed results on the mound of late, allowing four earned runs or more in four of his last eight trips to the mound. The left-hander remains one of the more inconsistent arms in the Tigers rotation to this point, carrying  a 4.10 ERA and 1.32 WHIP with a 5-6 record and 7.3 K/9 ratio across 19 starts.

author: Chase Davis
title: Jordan Walker preparing for HRD, goes deep vs. Brewers
desc: Jordan Walker went 1-for-4 in the loss to the Brewers with a home run, a run scored, three RBI, and two strikeouts.
impact: On the same day he announced he'll participate in the home run derby, Walker took Chad Patrick deep in the sixth inning. After Thursday's loss to Milwaukee, he's batting .294 with 22 home runs, a league-leading 73 RBI, 59 runs scored and 12 stolen bases across 90 games.

author: Chase Davis
title: Andre Pallante gets tagged for six in loss to Brewers
desc: Andre Pallante allowed six earned runs on eight hits and two walks while striking out two over five innings in Thursday's loss to the Brewers.
impact: Pallante ends his first half on a low note. He's now allowed five or more runs in two of his last three starts. After the loss, he now has a 3.96 ERA and 1.26 WHIP with a 10-6 record through 18 starts. His next start will come after the All-Star break against the Diamondbacks.

author: Nate Miller
title: Braden Shewmake designated for assignment Friday
desc: Braden Shewmake was designated for assignment before Friday's game against the Rangers.
impact: Shewmake was just activated from the IL earlier this week. However, with starting shortstop Jeremy Pena likewise returning from the IL on Friday, Shewmake was made the odd man out in Houston. Shewmake has posted a .695 OPS with three homers and four doubles across 83 plate appearances this season.

author: Nate Miller
title: Jeremy Pena (calf) officially activated Friday
desc: Jeremy Pena (calf) has been activated from the IL ahead of Friday's game against the Rangers.
impact: It was tentatively expected that Pena would return from the IL on Friday, and that has turned out to be the case. The 2025 All-Star has been putting together another solid season for the Astros, but multiple injuries have limited him to 48 games so far. Braden Shewmake was designated for assignment to make room on the roster for Pena.

author: Nate Miller
title: Dillon Dingler (hand) remains out of lineup Friday
desc: Dillon Dingler (hand) still missing from the Tigers' starting lineup on Friday.
impact: Dingler seems close to returning to action, but that won't happen Friday night. Jake Rogers will start behind the plate for the second consecutive day. Dingler could be held out until after the All-Star break at this point.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Shohei Ohtani (knee) scratched from start Friday, will DH
desc: Dodgers superstar Shohei Ohtani has been scratched from Friday's start due to left knee irritation, but will serve as the designated hitter against the D-backs.
impact: In a lengthy statement, the Dodgers announced Ohtani will serve as the designated hitter for the remainder of this weekend's series against the D-backs. Additionally, the club announced that Ohtani will have "interventions" done on his knee during the All-Star break, and the two-way star will be unable to travel to Philadelphia and participate in next week's All-Star game.
